checks.describe: capstone cluster is up with control-plane and two worker nodes
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone get nodes --no-headers | wc -l | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: capstone-app namespace exists with baseline workloads deployed
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone get ns capstone-app -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'

checks.describe: fault 1 injected — GPU worker tainted with maintenance=true:NoSchedule causing Pending pods
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone get pods -n capstone-app -l app=inference-worker --field-selector=status.phase=Pending --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \n'

checks.describe: fault 2 injected — CoreDNS Corefile has corrupt upstream forwarder (10.0.0.254)
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone -n kube-system get cm coredns -o jsonpath='{.data.Corefile}' | grep -c '10.0.0.254'

checks.describe: fault 3 injected — website-operator-src ConfigMap deleted, operator pod stuck
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone -n capstone-app get cm website-operator-src 2>&1

checks.describe: fault 4 injected — throttle-serviceaccounts FlowSchema exists routing SAs to 1-concurrency PriorityLevel
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone get flowschema throttle-serviceaccounts -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: fault 5 injected — capstone-junk namespace exists with junk ConfigMaps filling etcd
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-capstone get ns capstone-junk -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: fault 6 injected — ClusterQueue capstone-cq has nominalQuota cpu=0 blocking all jobs
